title: Portugal: Pickleball in the Algarve
summary: Discover a region where spectacular Atlantic landscapes, charming towns and authentic Portuguese traditions come together. From golden beaches and impressive coastal cliffs to local markets, gastronomy and picturesque villages, the Algarve offers the perfect setting for a journey filled with memorable experiences.

sections.html:
Discover a region where spectacular Atlantic landscapes, charming towns and authentic Portuguese traditions come together. From golden beaches and impressive coastal cliffs to local markets, gastronomy and picturesque villages, the Algarve offers the perfect setting for a journey filled with memorable experiences.

Enjoy the region at a relaxed pace, combining culture, nature and gastronomy, and discover why the Algarve is one of Portugal's most captivating destinations.

Visit the charming Old Town, with its cobblestone streets and medieval walls, the iconic Arco da Vila, the impressive Faro Cathedral, and the Carmo Church, famous for its Chapel of Bones. A perfect tour to experience the rich history and culture of Faro! Return to your hotel.

sections.title: Day 8 - Loulé & Tavira
sections.html:
Breakfast at the hotel

Breakfast at the hotel.

Visit to Loulé Market and Historic Centre

Today we invite you to discover a different side of the Algarve, travelling away from the famous coastal resorts to explore two of the region’s most charming and authentic towns. Departure for Loulé, a lively traditional market town in the heart of the Algarve. Visit its colourful covered market, a wonderful place to discover local products, regional flavours and traditional crafts. Stroll through the historic centre, with its narrow streets, small shops and characteristic Portuguese atmosphere.

Lunch on your terms

Lunch on your terms.

Explore Tavira and Fado Performance

After lunch, discover the charm of Tavira, one of the Algarve’s most picturesque towns, on a visit that combines a rich history, impressive architecture and an insight into Portugal’s cultural heritage. Begin your exploration in the heart of Tavira, where cobbled streets lead you through a town steeped in history and tradition. Visit the town’s iconic monuments, including the imposing Castle of Tavira (exterior), which offers panoramic views over the town and the surrounding landscape. Explore the Roman Bridge, a notable landmark spanning the River Gilão and connecting the two parts of the town. Tavira is a town with numerous churches, and you will also have the opportunity to admire the magnificent Church of Misericórdia (included), a remarkable example of Renaissance architecture. Afterwards, enjoy a unique experience with a live Fado performance (included) in a local church, where the moving and melancholic sound of Fado will transport you to the heart of Portuguese musical culture. Fado, often described as the musical soul of Portugal, will be performed in an intimate and historic setting, providing an unforgettable experience that will perfectly complement your exploration of Tavira’s rich history.
